rule "Bad field":
  rename "Unit Price" to price

rule "No semicolon":
  set total to price * quantity;

rule "No calculate":
  calculate total as price * quantity

rule "Guard first":
  set total to 0
  when price is greater than 100

rule "No check":
  set total to 0
  message "Invalid"

rule "Message last":
  check price is required
  message "Missing"
  set total to 0

rule "Two spaces":
    check price is required

rule "One argument":
  set name to lowercase(name, 2)

rule "No eval":
  set total to eval("price * quantity")
